messages:
Elliot: Quick Q — heading to SF Mid-Market office next week. 30-min lunch window. Any go-to quick spots nearby? Also flying to Berlin Fri night after meetup — looking for casual evening bites near Kreuzberg or Neukölln. Any recs? :airplane: :cutlery:
Sana: For SF 30-min? Hit Ike's (sandwich shop) or El Capitan tacos — both take <10 mins to order if you grab-and-go. La Boulangerie has salads if you want something light.
Rafael: +1 for Ike's. Also Sajj on 10th has fast bowls and huge portions. If you can walk 8 mins, Sam's Deli does solid sandwiches.
Marta: Berlin — go to Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap in Kreuzberg (long lines but worth it) or Burgermeister under the U-Bahn for late-night. For vegan, Vöner in Friedrichshain is great.
Elliot: Nice. Any sit-down dinner that's chill near Kreuzberg for a team meetup (6-8 ppl)?
Sana: NENI is fun (book ahead) or Markthalle Neun for market-style variety. If you want quieter, Zenkichi is quieter but pricier.
Rafael: If you like Vietnamese, Transit in Kreuzberg was chill. For beers + food trucks try the Revaler Strasse area — casual and quick.
Marta: Pro tip: in SF try ordering via DoorDash pickup to skip lines; in Berlin most places are cashless now (card or Apple Pay). Also bring a paper map? jk :map:
lunch-bot: Reminder: lunchtime meetup in SF kitchen at 12:30 on Tue — sign up here: <link>
Elliot: Thanks all — bookmarking. If anyone has a quick coffee rec near Mid-Market that stays open after 6pm, drop it here later.
